notes: Tailored retrieval evaluation set for the Agentic Workflows Zotero collection. This collection was detected locally but was not indexed at the time this file was created, so index collection 3 before running the evaluator.

questions.query: What do these papers say about cost, latency, routing, or budget tradeoffs for agentic systems?
